info.title: Team Formation API (Website ghép nhóm)
info.description:
Backend API for the Capstone Team Formation Website (requirements v2.9): same-major groups, semester rosters, moderation, finalization and Excel handover.

**How to call protected endpoints**
1. Students: `POST /api/v1/auth/google` with a Google ID token matching the imported roster.
   Admin/Moderator: `POST /api/v1/auth/login` with email and password.
2. Copy `accessToken` from the response.
3. Click **Authorize** (top right), paste the token (without `Bearer `) and confirm.

The token is remembered after a page reload. Each operation lists the roles allowed to call it; use the filter box to search tags.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Sign in and get a JWT. Start here. Students: Google and imported roster. Admin/Moderator: email and password.

tags.name: Semesters
tags.description: Semester list, common timeline and Moderator assignment (3.1, 3.6)

tags.name: Majors
tags.description: Students' majors; groups are formed within one major (3.3)

tags.name: Imports
tags.description: Student list with optional eligibility, and eligibility updates: preview, then confirm (4.1, 4.2)

tags.name: Subjects & scopes
tags.description: Capstone configuration and major scopes: phases, deadlines, extension, finalizing, reopening (3.2-3.5, 7.2)

tags.name: Student list
tags.description: List management by semester, subject and major; eligibility (4.3, 5)

tags.name: Groups
tags.description: Creating a group, the Leader's settings, lock, kick, leaving, search (6, 8.2)

tags.name: Requests
tags.description: Apply / Invite, Likes, leave requests and complaints, Leader transfer (6.2, 6.4, 8.2)

tags.name: Moderation
tags.description: The assigned Moderator arranges all groups in every phase, including after finalization, including locked groups (7.1)

tags.name: Profile
tags.description: My profile, private mode and my semesters

tags.name: Notifications
tags.description: My in-app notifications and the real-time stream
